## Line 393

```plato

    // The R3 point of the given index: the same recurrence one dimension up, its
    // increments the reciprocal powers of the root of x^4 = x + 1.
    PlasticPoint3D(index: Integer, offset: Number): Point3D {
        var p = GeneralizedGoldenRatio(3);
        var n = index.ToNumber;
        return Point3D(UnitFraction(offset + n / p),
                       UnitFraction(offset + n / (p * p)),
                       UnitFraction(offset + n / (p * p * p)));
    }
```
